text:
Evan (Partnerships): Quick sync: KeplerEdge + NexusWorks want to list next week. Need a firm split of public vs private artifacts and an upload owner. @Sam @June take?
Sam (Security): Public: 1-paragraph SOC2 extract + redacted pen test exec summary only. Private bundle: full SOC2 report, raw vuln scans, firmware debug dumps, full cert chains. No private keys or customer data anywhere.
June (Marketplace): Marketplace asks for a signed attestation PDF and predictable filenames under a public/ folder. Presigned links for reviewers should be 7-14 days. We also want a short evidence-index.txt inside the private bundle.
Rakesh (HW SI): From NexusWorks: they can provide a redacted SBOM, firmware hash file, and a sanitized patch history. They asked if a firmware-hash.txt is OK publicly.
Sam (Security): Firmware SHA256 pub OK. Do not publish build metadata or internal commit SHAs that map to customers. Sanitized patch history ok at high level.
Evan (Partnerships): Hana, any attestation wording constraints? KeplerEdge wants to claim "signed firmware" on listing. How to phrase?
Hana (Legal): Keep factual: "Firmware version X signed on YYYY-MM-DD using KeplerEdge signing key (public key available on request)." Avoid security guarantees or future commitments. Use standard marketplace attestation template.
s3-bot: presign preflight: upload prefix `s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/kepleredge-nexus-2026-03/`. Default presign TTL options: 604800 (7d) or 1209600 (14d). Example presign: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/kepleredge-nexus-2026-03/kepler-soc2-redacted.pdf --expires-in 1209600`.
June (Marketplace): Suggested public manifest for the listing:
- public/soc2-extract.pdf (1 page, redacted)
- public/pen-summary-redacted.pdf (1-2 pages)
- public/firmware-hash.txt (sha256 only)
- public/attestation-marketplace.pdf (signed by KeplerEdge)
And private bundle (presigned):
- private/full-soc2.pdf
- private/pen-full.pdf (redacted where needed by security)
- private/vuln-scan-raw.zip (private)
- private/evidence-index.txt (filenames + short descriptions)

Rakesh (HW SI): NexusWorks will run a scrub job to remove serials, hostnames and customer IDs before upload. We'll produce firmware-hash.txt and a short SBOM excerpt (vendor/package names only).
Sam (Security): Redaction checklist: remove device serials, MACs, customer names/emails, IP addresses, private keys, PKCS#12 files, and any trace logs containing secrets. Put a 1-2 line redaction note at top of each redacted doc. If in doubt, redact the paragraph.
Evan (Partnerships): Owners & deadlines: NexusWorks upload to presign path Tue EOD (Rakesh lead), Hana to finalize attestation template Tue noon, Sam redaction review Wed AM, June to issue presigns Wed PM, Partnerships to confirm listing copy Thu AM. Primary review contact: Evan, backup Rakesh.
June (Marketplace): Also need an internal escalation contact for reviewers. Evan, can you be primary?
Evan (Partnerships): Yes. Backup: Hana.
Hana (Legal): Attestation template link -> https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/marketplace_attestation_hw_v3.pdf
Sam (Security): One more note: do not include raw scanner output (Nmap, Nessus) on public or in any shared link without redaction. Always keep raw scans in private bundle only.
Rakesh (HW SI): We'll schedule the scrub CI to run on the NexusWorks artifact pipeline and upload to the presign path once green.
June (Marketplace): I'll post presign links in this thread when ready and attach a short reviewer checklist.
Evan (Partnerships): Thanks all. If we hit all deadlines we should be clear to go live next Friday. Ping here for any slips. :thumbsup:
